text:
irene: Heads-up - since the IDP proxy deploy at 03:20 UTC we're seeing intermittent h2 connection resets that cause SCIM syncs to fail with 502s and then weird attribute encoding on retries. Example log excerpt below. Anyone seen this pattern before?

kevin: seeing same. SCIM job spiked errors ~03:22 and kept retrying. KMS rotation completed at 03:00, could be related.

song-ops: are the 502s coming from the proxy to the IDP or from our SCIM worker to the proxy?

irene: proxy -> upstream IDP. stack shows HTTP/2 RST_STREAM 0x1e (ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM style resets) then our client retries and the payload ends up with truncated encryption header on certain attrs.

maria: can you paste the raw log snippet? also which attrs are affected?

irene: sure:

```
[03:22:11.123] proxy: h2: stream 342 reset: RST_STREAM 0x1e
[03:22:11.125] proxy: upstream connect idp-east-1:443 tls handshake OK
[03:22:11.126] proxy: request /scim/v2/Users sync_id=abc-123 payload_len=1842
[03:22:11.200] proxy: upstream response 200 but truncated: attr_encryption_header missing for extId
[03:22:11.201] scim-worker: POST /internal/ingest retry=1 err=InvalidAttributeEncoding
```

maria: extId attr missing header -> sounds like KMS envelope metadata stripped during proxy passthrough?

kevin: two hypotheses: 1) HTTP/2 stream resets interrupt chunked TLS frames and our middleware that attaches envelope headers fails on retry, or 2) proxy misconfig after h2 setting change drops certain headers if connection reuses are enabled.

song-ops: I can flip proxy to force HTTP/1.1 to test quickly. That will tell us if it's h2-specific. Want me to do it?

irene: please do a short A/B on a small percentage first (5%). Also turn on debug for "h2:frame" logging on proxy nodes.

sso-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-546 - IDP proxy h2 resets causing SCIM sync attr encoding failures. Pager duty notified.

kevin: while that's rolling, check SCIM worker code path where we reattach envelope headers after a retry. Maybe it's a race with KMS client cache invalidation after rotation.

maria: good call. KMS rekey at 03:00 might have changed the envelope key alias; if our cache now returns a different key id and we rewrap during retry without the metadata the reader expects, downstream validation fails. I will grep for usages of kmsClient.getKeyAlias() in scim-worker and add extra logging.

song-ops: flipped 5% traffic to h1 - first 20 requests show no resets and successful syncs. h2 nodes still noisy. Reverting to 0% and collecting debug logs.

irene: thanks. For triage: (a) collect proxy h2 frame logs, (b) dump headers on a failed request from worker side, (c) capture KMS cache entries around 03:00 from both proxy and scim-worker, (d) verify audit logs for rewrap operations.

audit-bot: note: audit retention policy will store KMS rewrap events for 90 days. Query id "rewrap:2026-03-18:03:00" for correlated events.

kevin: quick vuln triage note — if the proxy is dropping encryption metadata on retries, it could expose a window where attributes are stored unwrapped in transit. Need to confirm asap.

maria: I found a suspicious code path: when the scim-worker receives RST and retries, we call kmsClient.rewrapIfStale() which can return null if the KMS cache is in refresh state -> code proceeds and emits the payload without X-Envelope header. WTH. Pushing a patch to fail the retry instead of sending unwrapped payload.

irene: great. Song, hold off wide traffic change until we validate patch. Also keep proxy debug logs.

song-ops: ack. capturing logs to s3://redwood-triage/INC-2026-546/proxy-h2-debug.tar.gz

kevin: for immediate mitigation, we should enable strict header validation on our ingress so any payload missing envelope header is rejected with 400 instead of processed. I can open a quick PR to nginx config.

maria: patch landed in scim-worker to abort retry when rewrap null. Rolling to canary (3 instances).

irene: can you also add a post-deploy smoke that runs one full scim sync and verifies attributes decrypt correctly?

maria: yes, smoke script included. Canary results: 6/6 success, no InvalidAttributeEncoding.

song-ops: proxy h2 debug shows a pattern: sudden spikes of SETTINGS update from upstream and immediate RST_STREAM for long-lived streams. I'll contact the IDP provider to see whether they flipped h2 behavior during their deploy at 02:59.

irene: thanks — timeline so far: 03:00 KMS rotate, 03:20 IDP proxy deploy, 03:22 SCIM failures start. Tentative root cause: KMS cache edge case + HTTP/2 resets causing retry code path to emit payload lacking envelope header.

kevin: next actions: 1) keep scim-worker patch and ingress header validation until remote IDP confirms h2 stability, 2) schedule KMS cache robustness PR (add locking around rewrap), 3) follow up with IDP vendor about SETTINGS/RST pattern. I'll file follow-ups on INC ticket.

maria: will add unit tests for the rewrap failure mode and update release notes.

irene: closing slack thread for now — marking incident as mitigated, leaving incident open for postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sso-bot: INC-2026-546 status updated -> MITIGATED (temporary controls applied).
